a.en: Pre-order benefit - extras (often PCs) for ordering in a window from a specific shop.
a.bg: Pre-order benefit - extras (често PC) за поръчка в прозорец от конкретен shop.

a.en: Different photobooks/covers/PCs drive collecting and physical sales metrics.
a.bg: Различни photobook/cover/PC варианти движат collecting и physical sales.

q.en: Can I bring a generic light stick?
q.bg: Мога ли с generic light stick?

a.en: Sometimes yes, sometimes no - always check venue/artist rules.
a.bg: Понякога да, понякога не - винаги проверявай venue/artist rules.

q.en: How do I convert KST times?

a.en: Korea is UTC+9. Bulgaria (EET/EEST) is typically 6-7 hours behind KST depending on DST.
a.bg: Корея е UTC+9. България (EET/EEST) обикновено е 6-7 часа назад според DST.

a.en: Pre-show performance segment; entry often needs special tickets/benefits.
a.bg: Сегмент преди шоуто; входът често иска специални билети/benefits.

q.en: What is hi-touch / video call fansign?
q.bg: Какво е hi-touch / video call fansign?

a.en: Fan events with brief artist interaction; entries usually require album purchases via official rules.
a.bg: Фен събития с кратък контакт; entry обикновено чрез албуми по official rules.

a.en: Different packaging tiers - digipacks are often slimmer with fewer inclusions.
a.bg: Различни опаковки - digipack често е по-тънък с по-малко inclusions.

a.en: Photocards only from a specific retailer’s pre-order/sale window.
a.bg: Photocard-и само от прозореца на конкретен retailer.
